name: Can I integrate new trim with existing trim during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I integrate new trim with existing trim during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Integrating new trim with existing trim is possible, but it requires careful consideration to ensure a seamless transition and consistent aesthetic. Factors like wood species, profile matching, and paint or stain finishes must be meticulously coordinated. AKN Design Group's expertise in whole-home remodels includes finish carpentry, where we focus on achieving a cohesive look across all elements, whether blending new with old or installing entirely new trim throughout your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Integrating new and existing trim requires careful matching of profiles, wood species, and finishes. AKN Design Group's finish carpentry expertise ensures a cohesive look during remodels.
